profile.name: 文件持久化存储系统
profile.description: 用于将项目、数据项属性及相关数据持久保存到文件中的软件存储组件，常见于实验数据管理、结果归档与后续读取场景。该对象表示文件型持久化存储系统，而非独立物理实验设备。
profile.description_en: A software storage component that persistently saves projects, data item properties, and related data to files. It is typically used for laboratory data management, result archiving, and later retrieval. This represents a file-based persistent storage system rather than a standalone physical lab instrument.

registry.name: File Persistent Storage
registry.description: File Persistent Storage System是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、写入数据、加载、复位、读取数据、运动控制。支持Signal, Slot, clear property等操作。
